description: One page of a category's products across every site of its department that has the category (products with a shop offer in the locale's market first), with their lowest offer, site and page URL, the subcategories and whether there are more pages.

locale.description: Language and market (nl-NL = Dutch for the Netherlands, fr-BE = French for Belgium, de-DE = German for Germany, en-NL = English for the Netherlands; FR, DK and SE too). Shops, prices, currency and stock are per market; only sites that serve the locale answer. Default nl-NL.

name: browse_category
title: Products of a category
